text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text: “—Haaaaah...!!”

text_block_list.name: Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text: "Waaah...!"

text_block_list.name: Young Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "You're so fast, Big Sis! So cool~♡"

text_block_list.name: Young Cheval
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, I want to be just like Big 
Sis... Big Sis, you're truly... 
amazing...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Cool" and "amazing"—that's who I am. 
Someone worthy of being everyone's 
aspiration.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Because— I'm the big sister, after all!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Cheval, Vivlos. Just you wait. I will 
definitely show both of you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Standing at the top— that is my big 
sister!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what was my time?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, she's maintaining her pace 
perfectly!
Yeah, you're maintaining your pace well!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu, simply perfection.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's pick up the pace and try again. 
Let's see if you can maintain this at 
around 85% max heart rate.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Of course. Who do you take me for?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I will make sure to maintain total 
control next time as well. Let's resume 
after a short rest."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina— Proud, gorgeous, and undeniably 
gifted. She is the Umamusume I train.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right now, she is stoically training hard 
toward her debut. Her motivation for 
giving it her all is—
Big siiis!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Good work♡ You were super fast~. That's 
our big sis for you!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hey, Cheval-chi♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: D-Don't throw this onto me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina is the eldest of the three 
sisters. And these are her younger 
sisters... The second daughter, Cheval 
Grand, and the youngest, Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—they were the ones who were Verxina's 
'motive.'

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh. Were you two watching it together?
choice_data_list:
(The atmosphere just softened all at 
once...)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Cheval-chi said she wants to go♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ! N-No! Vivlos forced me into it...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I'm so glad.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If both of you are watching, I can try 
even harder. Just you wait and see.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Without fail, I'll stand at the very top!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing at the pinnacle... That is 
Verxina's grand ambition. It's the goal 
she strives for, all to guide her younger 
sisters.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse! I'm so totally looking 
forward to it~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then! When's your debut? 
Tomorrow? The day after??

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Geez... No, I still have a long way to go. 
I'm nowhere near good enough yet.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, after all that?! No way, that's 
gotta be a lie!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer! Your big sis can debut real 
soon, right~?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I just can't forgive it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because... I haven't beaten "her" even 
once yet.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my. You are looking exceptionally 
gallant today.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Did something happen to sober her up, I 
wonder?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Good day. Should you not greet me 
first?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I added a little twist of my own. Just 
think about it for a moment—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Saying "Good day" to you? I'm already sick 
of saying it to you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Though it seems playing around won't be 
necessary. In that case, the usual routine 
will do nicely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Gentildonna. An Umamusume 
likely to debut in the same class as 
Verxina. And—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
As always—allow me to watch that 
frustrated look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—The opponent whom Verxina challenged 
time and again in match races and 
beyond... only to face defeat every single 
time.”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...No, today... Today will unfold 
entirely differently!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: “—Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"'It can't be...!!!! To think that I... 
could lose...! This can't be...!!!!'"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That day I lost to you for the first 
time... my destiny changed.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If I cannot triumph over you, how could I 
ever claim the pinnacle?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Please, brace yourself. If you're caught 
off guard when you lose, it's going to 
hurt tremendously!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like Verxina, Gentildonna showed 
immense prowess even before her debut. A 
race between the two of them would 
overflow with sheer fighting spirit—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, while the race started with 
Verxina in the lead, gradually... little 
by little, the gap began to widen—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ngh…………!!!! Uuuuugh……!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Just one more step! Just one more, and 
yet...! Aaaaaagh...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Please wait, Gentildonna-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
May I ask about your next plans? This 
time, I will certainly claim victory over 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina lost once again. However, she 
isn't one to give up here. That's how 
she's faced this showdown time and time 
again.
choice_data_list:
(She was closer than before today. Next 
time for sure—)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —I must decline.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Excuse me, but may I ask the reason 
why?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The date for my debut has finally been 
decided. I, too, shall officially enter 
the Twinkle Series. Which means――

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I no longer have time to entertain you. 
Pardon me, won't you?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer... What do you think I should 
do?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...If I stay defeated by Ms. Gentil, 
there's no way I can ever stand at the 
top."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, until I acquire the 
strength befitting it... Or so I thought, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina is troubled. However, her struggle 
seems less about which direction to take, 
and more about making the decision itself.
choice_data_list: Seems like you already know that yourself.
Seems like you already know that yourself.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Now that things have come to this, I 
can't afford to take my time. I should 
lock in my debut as well."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
As she gains experience, the gap will only 
widen further. ...However.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I always want to appear perfect in front 
of my little sisters."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Having pride alone doesn't get you 
anywhere, does it?"
choice_data_list:
Still, it's a matter of pride to you, 
right?

Still, it's a matter of pride to you, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list:
Because that's an important motivation for 
you.
Because that's what truly motivates you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is very precious—my very starting 
point.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's decide on your debut date!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
choice_data_list:
It's easier to find your strength when you 
can see the finish line

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, you judged that doing so 
would make you stronger, correct?"
choice_data_list: Let's keep moving forward as we grow!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Understood. I shall press forward.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—To become someone my sister can be proud 
of!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to hold back. Make me... 
even stronger than that person!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—I will definitely, never let myself be 
broken!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our days of training together with 
Verxina for the Twinkle Series began!
